title: The Gully Cup Robbery
call: Inspector {name}, the Gully Cup trophy has vanished from the cricket pavilion.
The final is tied, the rain has stopped, and there's nothing to give the winners!
arrival: Wet players stand in the outfield, staring at an empty trophy case.

examination.title: Examine the trophy case

spots.title: Shelf
spots.text: A clean circle in the dust, where the trophy stood.

spots.title: Glass door
spots.text: Fresh rain drops on the INSIDE of the glass.

spots.title: Wall clock
spots.text: Stopped at 4:15, when the storm cut the power.

examination.question: When was the trophy taken?
options: 🌧️ In the rain break, during the power cut
examination.why: Rain inside the glass and a clock stopped at 4:15: someone opened the case in the dark, during the rain break.

interview.alibi: I was giving my team a talk in the dressing room. They all heard me shouting!
replies: Of course I wear spikes, I'm the captain. Every player does.
I'm right-handed. Look at my batting gloves.
Red cap, yes. But why would I steal my own team's trophy?
interview.release: The whole Red Caps team heard Rohit's team talk during the power cut.

interview.alibi: I was in the canteen eating samosas, waiting for the rain to stop.
replies: Spikes? Every player wears spikes, Inspector.
gotchas: You bowl with your LEFT hand, Dev. And this is a left handprint, right next to the latch!
This is YOUR cap, Dev, number 11. Your teammates are all wearing theirs!

interview.alibi: I was helping the groundsmen cover the pitch. I'm still soaked!
replies: Spikes, yes. All the players wear them.
Left-handed, yes. But my hands were inside wet keeping gloves all evening.
My cap? It's right here on my head, dripping.
interview.release: The groundsmen say Salman helped them cover the pitch for the whole break.

leads.question: The thief came in from the soaked ground. What would they leave on the pavilion's wooden floor?
wrongWhy: Gloves don't touch the floor. Look down!
Nobody had an umbrella. The storm came suddenly.
leads.reveal: Shoe prints! Pandu shines his torch along the floor…
leads.name: Spike prints
leads.found: Muddy prints from the door to the case, full of **tiny holes**. Those are **SPIKED cricket shoes**.
leads.ask: Cross out everyone who does NOT wear spiked shoes.
leads.why: Only the players wore spikes today.
leads.card: SPIKE prints going to the trophy case

leads.from: 👣 The spike prints stop right at the glass door
leads.question: The thief had to pull open the stiff glass door. What would that leave behind?
wrongWhy: The lock wasn't used. The door just pulls open.
leads.reveal: A handprint! Pandu dusts the glass…
leads.name: Handprint
leads.found: A clear **LEFT** handprint next to the latch. The thief yanked the stiff door with their strong hand. A **red thread** is caught on the latch.
leads.ask: Tap everyone left who is left-handed.
leads.why: Dev, Salman and Kiran are all left-handed. Keep an eye on them.
leads.card: A LEFT handprint on the glass

leads.from: 🧵 A red thread caught on the latch, at head height
leads.question: The thread is red and woolly, caught as the thief leaned in. What was it from?
wrongWhy: Nobody wore a scarf. It's summer!
There's no rope in the pavilion.
leads.reveal: A cap! You look under the bench…
leads.name: Lost cap
leads.found: A **RED CAPS** team cap with a torn thread, dropped in the dark. Every Blue Caps player still has theirs.
leads.ask: Cross out everyone left who is NOT in the Red Caps team.
leads.why: Kiran plays for the Blue Caps.
leads.card: A RED CAPS cap under the bench

confession: "I owed a moneylender two lakh rupees, and he was coming for it. That trophy is real gold plating. I thought nobody would notice in the dark."
escapeStory: Dev slipped out through the parking lot. Police found the trophy at a pawn shop the next morning, with his name on the receipt.
